--- comments: true difficulty: Easy --- # [17.01. Add Without Plus](https://leetcode.cn/problems/add-without-plus-lcci) [中文文档](/lcci/17.01.Add%20Without%20Plus/README.md) ## Description

Write a function that adds two numbers. You should not use + or any arithmetic operators.

Example:


Input: a = 1, b = 1

Output: 2

 

Note:

  • a and b may be 0 or negative.
  • The result fits in 32-bit integer.
## Solutions ### Solution 1 > **Thinking** > > Add without $+,-,*,/$. A loop that adds would break the rule; simulating pencil-and-paper on strings is longer. > > XOR is the sum without carry; AND shifted left is the carry. Repeat until the carry vanishes. > > $sum=a\oplus b$ and $carry=(a\& b)\ll 1$ are written back into $a$ and $b$. The sign bit follows arithmetic shift; the loop is $O$(bit width). #### Java ```java class Solution { public int add(int a, int b) { int sum = 0, carry = 0; while (b != 0) { sum = a ^ b; carry = (a & b) << 1; a = sum; b = carry; } return a; } } ``` #### Swift ```swift class Solution { func add(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Int { var a = a var b = b var sum = 0 var carry = 0 while b != 0 { sum = a ^ b carry = (a & b) << 1 a = sum b = carry } return a } } ```
